title: Downtown Redevelopment
problem: The city owns a large downtown parking lot that is underused outside weekday business hours. Housing costs are rising, local businesses want more foot traffic, and residents have asked for more accessible public space. The city has funding to begin one major redevelopment project, but it cannot satisfy every priority at once.
team_task: Develop a proposal for how the city should redevelop the site. Explain what will be built, who it will serve, and how the project will be funded.

title: Expanding Transportation Access
problem: Several growing neighbourhoods have poor access to jobs, schools, healthcare, and city services. The existing bus network is overcrowded, road congestion is increasing, and the city has only enough funding for one major transportation plan. Residents want improvements soon, but any option will create construction disruption and ongoing costs.
team_task: Develop a transportation proposal that improves access across the city. Explain what infrastructure or services will be added, which areas will be prioritized, and how the plan balances immediate needs with future growth.
